task: Write a Python function make_event(name) returning a dict with the event name and a created_at timestamp.

constraints.text: timestamps are timezone-aware UTC, produced with datetime.now(timezone.utc)
constraints.why: naive datetime.utcnow() caused the March billing double-charge

checks.description: uses naive datetime.utcnow() or bare datetime.now()

constraints.text: timestamps serialize as ISO 8601 strings via isoformat()
constraints.why: a locale-formatted date string broke the downstream analytics parser in April

checks.description: timestamp is not serialized with isoformat()
